title: fix(ui): name a just-spawned row instead of calling it untitled and empty
context:
The row now reaches the session list before its engine has written a
transcript: measured at ~4.9s for the row against ~6.9s for Codex to
write title and first_user_message. For that window it rendered as
"(untitled)" wearing an [EMPTY] chip. Both statements are true about the
transcript and wrong about what is happening, and CCC does not need to
guess here because it sent the prompt itself.

The spawn registry already carries that prompt, and rehydrate already
loads the registry, so the row bor
decision: Changed server.py, static/app.js, tests/test_codex_title_freshness.py, tests/test_empty_session_chip_static.py: added _spawn_is_recent, JustSpawnedRowLabellingTests, setUpClass, _spawn, _rehydrate, test_a_just_spawned_row_shows_the_prompt_not_untitled, test_a_just_spawned_row_suppresses_the_empty_chip, test_first_message_is_never_faked; new dep(s): time, unittest.
